property_summary: After any number of addToBalance calls, the userBalance of any address must equal the sum of all Ether sent by that address; the buggy version keeps userBalance unchanged, so the invariant fails for any non-zero value.
change_summary: Replace `userBalance[msg.sender] = add_uint256(userBalance[msg.sender], msg.value);` with `userBalance[msg.sender] = userBalance[msg.sender];` so the balance never increases.
